title: RAID LINES IN THE SHOOTER VOICE
why: His order of 2026-10-09: every raid line reads like Call of Duty, Fortnite or ARC Raiders, a short caps headline and only when needed a short detail, never advice or an explaining sentence. The review of the queue builds found eight lines still in the old voice. A full backpack now says BACKPACK FULL with the key that drops an item (or, with autoloot on, the count and Nothing to drop). A teammate going down says NAME DOWN with Hold E to revive. A box a teammate holds says NAME IS SEARCHING. Pressing E on a ring already called says EXTRACTION INBOUND and the time, with no advice to stay alive. A teammate calling says NAME CALLED FOR EXTRACTION with the ring and the time. The zoom keys say ZOOM 115% on one row. Your rival says RIVAL IN THE AREA with his name as the detail, with no explaining sentence.
now: Eight more raid lines read as short caps callouts: BACKPACK FULL, NAME DOWN, NAME IS SEARCHING, EXTRACTION INBOUND, NAME CALLED FOR EXTRACTION, ZOOM and RIVAL IN THE AREA.
